# Ultravi0let

> A senior-only product studio in Cairo, remote-first, founded in 2024. Senior engineers who launch your product, then stay on as your tech team. Design, engineering, cloud and AI, from first prototype to production.

Contact: hello@ultravi0let.com

## Services
- Product engineering: design and build the product, from first prototype through launch.
- Backend, data & cloud: APIs, data and cloud infrastructure.
- AI engineering: LLM, RAG and agent systems for production.
- Also in the work: interface design, systems architecture, integrations, and care after launch.

## How to engage
1. Discovery: a fixed-price scoping sprint of about two weeks that ends in a launch plan.
2. Launch: a fixed-scope build to production.
3. Tech Team: a monthly retainer. We stay on as the engineering team — features, infrastructure, on-call and AI.

## How we work
Four phases on the site: Discovery, Architecture, Build (short cycles, a demo every Friday), Launch & Care. They map onto the three engagements above.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.ultravi0let.com/): who we are, selected work, services, how to engage, process, testimonials and contact.
